page.overview:
Who is Arctic Monks?

Arctic Monks belongs to Mortal Kombat. The Arctic Monks were a group of holymen found in Arctika.

They helped Taven to locate the Lin Kuei Temple, (formerly known as the Temple of Delia) if he rescued their abbot. The Arctic Monks were worshipping an obelisk that was of Edenian design, meaning they were knowingly aware of the fact that the obelisk was created by Delia and her immortal husband Argus.

In Mortal Kombat, Arctic Monks sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
